# FaceAlarm

> Face Yoga Tracker - AI-Powered Progress Tracking. Wake up, take a selfie, see your transformation.

FaceAlarm is a free mobile app (iOS & Android) that helps users track their face yoga and facial exercise progress over time. It uses AI-powered face alignment to ensure consistent selfie angles, making it easy to see real transformation results.

## Core Features

- Daily Selfie Alarm: Set a recurring alarm to remind you to take your daily progress photo
- AI Face Alignment: Ghost overlay ensures you match your previous selfie angle every time
- Streak Tracking: Build and maintain daily streaks to stay motivated
- Calendar Gallery: View all your progress photos organized by date
- Timelapse Generator: Create before/after timelapse videos from your photos
- Progress Sharing: Share your transformation with friends or on social media

## Privacy

FaceAlarm is 100% private. All photos are stored locally on your device. No cloud uploads, no account required, works fully offline. No subscriptions.

## Use Cases

- Face yoga practitioners tracking facial exercise results
- Gua sha enthusiasts monitoring skin improvements
- Skincare routines progress documentation
- Post-procedure recovery tracking
- General facial transformation journaling
